in_marathi.name: Purvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Purvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Purvansh is derived from two Sanskrit words, 'Purva' meaning ancient or old and 'Ansh' meaning soul or essence. The name signifies the legacy or essence of one's ancestors.
